title: When it all reflects
author: Geethanjali Dilip
text:
The tides in anguish,
The seething fire in her womb,
The ice clad mountains ,
Alive she breathes in a frozen tomb,
Her soft rosy petals blooming,
Braving the thorns with grit,
Undulations a plenty,
Fluid as water and gracefully fit,
Ever in a dance her cadence is sheer beauty,
Internalize her energy peacefully,
For duality is her game,
The demon, the monster, the angel,
Soaked in every soul`s name,
The good , the bad and the ugly,
She nurtures them all with panache,
Some with gruel, some with broth,
Some with porridge and some with ganache,
But feed she will from her womb fecund,
With that sweet fire called earthiness,
With loving arms in an embrace, perennial nectar in a bund,
Call her woman, call her lady,
Call her your girl and beloved,
Along with her you will spin if only you are ready,
And feel how you brim with an inexplicable feeling blessed.

When it all reflects in little things,
Daisies, violets, mould and shrooms,
Mist, tsunamis, hurricanes and dooms,
It`s thoughts that have gone into her lap,
As she sprawls in an expanding map,
Hold on to her tight
Just love her with all your might.
